DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日はホースの洗浄を一緒に行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Today we'll clean the hoses together.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お願いします。このホースはもうタンクから外していい状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 洗浄前のホースの使用終了を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. Is this hose ready to be disconnected from the tank now?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm that the hose is no longer in use before cleaning it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 担当が使用終了を確認した方だけです。こちらの札付きの一本を扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Only the one whose use the responsible staff have confirmed is finished. Please handle this single hose with the tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 札付きの一本ですね。まだタンクにつながっている方には触りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 札のある対象だけ扱うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: The one with the tag, right? I won't touch the one still connected to the tank.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will handle only the tagged hose. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。先に残液を指定の容器へ受けます。容器はこの台に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: That's right. First we'll drain the remaining liquid into the designated container. Put the container on this stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この容器ですね。口元が低いので、跳ねないように持つ位置を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 受け容器を特定し飛散を避ける保持の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: This container, right? Its opening is low. Could you show me where to hold the hose so the liquid won't splash?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Identify the receiving container and ask for a demonstration of how to hold the hose to avoid splashing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 私が実演します。圧力や薬剤の操作は担当者が行うので、自分でバルブを回さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: I'll demonstrate. The responsible staff handle pressure and chemicals, so don't turn any valves yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 位置が分かりました。手袋が濡れたら、途中でも交換できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 実演を理解し濡れた手袋の交換を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: I understand the position now. If my gloves get wet, may I change them even in the middle of the task?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Show that you understood the demonstration and ask about replacing wet gloves. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 交換してください。替えは洗浄台の横です。作業を再開する前に私へ声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Please replace them. Spares are next to the cleaning bench. Tell me before restarting the task.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 濡れたら交換して声を掛けます。まず実演を見て、札付きのホースだけ扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 交換後の連絡と実演からの開始を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: If they get wet, I'll change them and tell you. First I'll watch the demonstration and handle only the tagged hose.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will notify the other person after changing gloves and start by watching the demonstration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それでは洗浄台へどうぞ。足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Then please come to the cleaning bench. Watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll start checking out your purchases.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お願いします。パンがつぶれないように、先に別の袋へ入れてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: パンを先に分けて袋詰めしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. So the bread won't get crushed, may I put it in a separate bag first?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask to separate and bag the bread first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: パンを先に読み取りますので、その後にお取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll scan the bread first. Please take it after that.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この布の袋に入れます。重い牛乳はあとで入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 布袋を示し重い牛乳の順序を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. I'll put it in this cloth bag. I'd like to put the heavy milk in later.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Show your cloth bag and explain the order for packing the heavy milk. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。卵は別に持たれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: All right. Will you carry the eggs separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 卵は牛乳と同じ袋ですが、一番上に置きます。かごを袋詰め台まで使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 卵の位置を示しかごを台まで使いたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: The eggs will be in the same bag as the milk, but I'll put them on top. May I use the basket as far as the bagging counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: State where the eggs will go and ask to use the basket up to the bagging counter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 会計後にかごごと運んでいただけます。お支払い方法はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: After paying, you can take the basket with you. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 電子マネーです。残高が足りなければ、残りを現金で払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 電子マネー不足時の現金併用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: With electronic money. If the balance isn't enough, can I pay the rest in cash?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask about combining cash with electronic money if the balance is insufficient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: このレジでは分けて払えます。まず端末にかざしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: This checkout allows split payments. Please hold it over the reader first.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: かざします。パンの袋だけ先に持って、残りは台で詰めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 支払いと残りの袋詰め場所を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll hold it over the reader. I'll take just the bread bag first and pack the rest at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide how to pay and where to pack the remaining items. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。かごは台の下へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. Please return the basket under the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ご予約のパンのお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Are you here to collect the bread you reserved?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、佐藤です。チーズパン四個を予約しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 予約名とチーズパン四個を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, I'm Sato. I reserved four cheese breads.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: State the reservation name and the order for four cheese breads. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 佐藤様ですね。こちらです。温めてお渡ししましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Sato, correct? Here they are. Shall I warm them for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今夜食べるので、温めずにお願いします。袋は二個ずつに分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 今夜用なので温めを断り二個ずつの袋分けを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll eat them tonight, so please don't warm them. Can you put two in each bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decline warming because the bread is for tonight, and ask for bags containing two each. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。片方はどなたかへお渡しになるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Of course. Will you be giving one of the bags to someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 職場の同僚へ渡します。チーズ入りと分かるように、袋に名前を書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 贈る相手を話し商品名表示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll give it to a coworker. Could you write the product name on the bag so they can tell it contains cheese?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say who you will give it to and ask for the product name to be shown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 商品名のシールを両方に貼れます。よろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: We can put a product-name label on both bags. Is that all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それでお願いします。予約の時に払った分で、今日は支払いなしですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: シールを選び事前払いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, please. I paid when I reserved them, so there's nothing to pay today, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose the labels and confirm that you have already paid. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、四個分のお代はいただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: That's right. We've received payment for all four.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 確認できました。二袋ともシールを付けて、温めずに受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 表示と袋分けと未加熱受取を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: That's confirmed, then. I'll take them without warming, with labels on both bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm the labels, separate bags, and collection without warming. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 初めてのご来院でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。詰め物が取れました。今日は時間がないので、まず相談だけしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 初診で詰め物が取れ相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. A filling came out. I don't have much time today, so I'd just like to discuss it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say that this is your first visit, a filling has come out, and you would like a consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: どの歯ですか。痛みや出血はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Which tooth is it? Do you have any pain or bleeding?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 右の奥歯です。今は痛みも出血もありません。取れた物は持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 歯の位置と症状と持参物を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: A back tooth on the right. There's no pain or bleeding now. I brought the piece that came out.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Describe the tooth's location, symptoms, and what you brought. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 診察で状態を確認します。処置の範囲は歯科医師と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: We'll check the condition during the examination. Please discuss how much treatment to do with the dentist.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日は十五時には出たいです。すぐ直せるかも、先生に聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 帰る希望時刻を示し処置可能性の相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'd like to leave by three p.m. today. Can I also ask the dentist whether it can be fixed straight away?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: State your preferred departure time and ask to discuss whether treatment is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そのお時間とご希望を伝えます。今はお薬を使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'll pass on that time and your request. Are you currently taking any medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 使っていません。取れた物は、このケースのまま渡していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 服薬状況を答え持参物の渡し方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: No. Can I hand over the piece in this case?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Answer about your medication use and ask how to hand over the piece you brought. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、診察室で先生にお見せください。受付ではケースをお預かりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, please show it to the dentist in the examination room. We won't take the case at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 手元に持っておきます。十五時までの相談希望を、先生へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: ケースを保持し時刻制限の伝達を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'll keep it with me. Please tell the dentist I'd like a consultation that finishes by three p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Keep the case with you and ask for your time limit to be passed on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 承りました。お呼びするまでお掛けください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Certainly. Please have a seat until you're called. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お探しの本はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Is there a book you're looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 予約した本が届いたとメールが来ました。今日はカードを忘れたので、借りずに期限を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: カードを忘れた予約本の期限を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I received an email saying the book I reserved has arrived. I forgot my card today, so rather than borrow it, I'd like to ask about the collection deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask about the collection deadline for your reserved book because you forgot your card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お名前と予約された本の題名をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Please give me your name and the title of the book you reserved.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 田中です。『庭で育てる野菜』です。明後日まで取り置きと書いてありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 氏名と書名とメールの期限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'm Tanaka. It's 'Vegetables to Grow in Your Garden.' The email said it would be held until the day after tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: State your name, the book title, and the deadline in the email. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらでも明後日までになっています。その日までにご来館できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Our record also says the day after tomorrow. Can you come by then?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 明後日は出張です。明日の閉館前なら来られますが、何時まで受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 出張を理由に前日の受取可能時間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll be away on business the day after tomorrow. I can come before closing tomorrow. Until what time can I collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a business trip and ask how late you can collect the book the day before. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 明日は十八時までです。受け取りに必要なカードをお忘れなく。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Tomorrow we're open until six p.m. Don't forget the card needed to collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 十七時半に来ます。予約本は普通の貸出カウンターで受け取るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 来館時刻を決め受取カウンターを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll come at five thirty p.m. Do I collect reserved books at the regular lending counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose your arrival time and ask which counter to use for collection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、カウンターでカードと予約本の受け取り希望をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. Show your card at the counter and say that you would like to collect a reserved book.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 分かりました。メールを控えて、明日十七時半にカードを持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: メール控えとカードを持参する予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I see. I'll keep a copy of the email and come tomorrow at five thirty with my card.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to bring a copy of the email and your card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED.translation: We look forward to seeing you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 郵便のお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Are you here for a postal procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 転居届を書いています。この電話番号の欄は、新しい家の固定電話ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 転居届の連絡番号の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'm filling in a change-of-address notice. Is this phone-number field for the landline at my new home?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask what the contact-number field on the change-of-address notice means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 内容の確認で連絡できる番号をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Please enter a number where we can reach you to confirm the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 固定電話はないので、携帯番号を書きます。日中は電話に出られないことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 携帯番号と応答しにくい時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I don't have a landline, so I'll write my mobile number. Sometimes I can't answer during the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Give your mobile number and explain when it is difficult to answer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: つながらない場合は、あらためて連絡することがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: If we can't reach you, we may contact you again later.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 分かりました。旧住所の部屋番号も、新住所の部屋番号も書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 新旧両方の部屋番号記入を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I see. I need to write the room number for both my old address and my new one, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should enter the room numbers for both addresses. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、住所の欄にそれぞれ記入してください。抜けがないかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, please enter each one in its address field. Check that you haven't left anything out.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 両方書きました。引っ越し日と、郵便を移してほしい日は同じでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 住所を記入し転送希望日の書き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I've written both. Can the moving date and the date I'd like my mail forwarded from be the same?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Fill in the addresses and ask how to enter the preferred forwarding date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ご希望の日付をご記入ください。開始までの扱いは受付時に担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Please enter your preferred date. The staff will check how the period before forwarding begins will be handled when accepting the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 引っ越す来週の月曜を書きます。記入が終わったので、内容を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 希望日を記入し内容確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll write next Monday, when I move. I've finished filling it in. Could you check the contents?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Enter your preferred date and ask for the contents to be checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 承りました。窓口で確認いたします。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Certainly. We'll check it at the counter. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: どのようなお手続きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: What procedure would you like to carry out?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 名字が変わりました。通帳は前の名字ですが、窓口で相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 改姓後に旧姓通帳の相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: My surname has changed. My bankbook is in my old surname. Can I ask about this at the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about a bankbook in your old surname after a name change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。氏名変更の担当へご案内します。本人確認書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. I'll direct you to the name-change staff. Do you have identification with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 新しい名字の書類を持っています。通帳と一緒に出せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 新姓本人確認書類と通帳の提示を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I have documents in my new surname. Should I show them together with my bankbook?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask about showing identification in your new surname along with your bankbook. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 担当が新旧の氏名を確認できる資料を拝見します。ほかに資料はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: The staff will look at documents that allow them to verify both the new and old names. Do you have any other documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 変更前の名前が載った書類は今日はありません。家にある物を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 新旧名資料が未持参と話し必要物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I don't have anything showing my previous name with me today. I'd like to check which things I have at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say that you haven't brought documents showing your old and new names and ask what is needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 担当から必要な資料をご案内します。今日はまだ口座名義を変更せず、相談だけにできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: The staff will explain the documents you need. Today you can just ask for advice without changing the account name yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 相談だけでお願いします。仕事先へ出す振込先の名前も、今は前の名字になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 相談のみを選び現登録名を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I'd just like advice, please. For the name on the payment account I give my workplace, would it still be my old surname for now?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose a consultation only and ask about the name currently registered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 口座の現在の登録名を担当が確認してお伝えします。勤務先の届出方法は勤務先へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: The staff will check and tell you the name currently registered on the account. Please consult your workplace about how to submit the details to them.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず今の登録名と変更に必要な資料を、担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 現登録名と変更資料の確認範囲を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I see. First, I'll ask the staff about the currently registered name and the documents needed to change it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide to check the currently registered name and the documents needed for the change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それでは担当窓口へご案内します。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-NISHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'll show you to the responsible counter. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りですか。タオルのお忘れ物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you leaving? Have you remembered your towel?

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分のタオルがまだぬれています。かばんへ入れる前に水を切れる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ぬれた私物タオルの水を切る場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: My own towel is still wet. Is there somewhere I can drain the water out before putting it in my bag?
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to wring out your wet personal towel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 脱衣所の洗面台をお使いください。床に水が落ちないよう、流しの上でお願いします。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use the washbasin in the changing room. Do it over the sink so no water drips onto the floor.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 流しの上で絞ります。ここに掛かっているタオルと間違えないよう、赤い印も見ておきます。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 流しで絞り赤い印で自分の物を区別すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll wring it out over the sink. I'll also check the red mark so I don't confuse it with the towel hanging here.
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will wring it out over the sink and identify your own towel by its red mark. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 赤い印の物がお客様のですね。持ち帰り用の袋も受付にございます。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: The one with the red mark is yours, then. We also have bags for taking things home at reception.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋を一枚ください。かばんの中の本がぬれないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本がぬれないよう持帰り袋を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: One bag, please. I want to keep the book in my bag from getting wet.
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a bag to take it home in so your book won't get wet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。袋の口を閉じてから、かばんへお入れください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here you are. Please close the bag before putting it in your own bag.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: タオルを入れて口を結びました。借りた足拭き用のマットはこちらに返せますか。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋を閉じたと伝え借用マットの返却先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put the towel inside and tied the opening shut. Can I return the foot mat I borrowed here?
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have closed the bag and ask where to return the borrowed mat. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: マットは右の回収かごへお願いします。タオルはお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put the mat in the collection basket on the right. Take your towel home with you.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: マットはかごへ、赤い印のタオルはかばんへ入れました。お世話になりました。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 私物の収納とマットの返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put the mat in the basket and the towel with the red mark in my bag. Thank you for everything.
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have packed your own towel and returned the mat. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご利用ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-HYG-TOYOKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for using our facilities. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の担当は三階です。この部屋は連泊のお客様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're assigned to the third floor today. The guest in this room is staying for consecutive nights.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 机に資料が広がっています。机の上はそのままにして、床から始めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 私物の資料を残して床を清掃してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are papers spread across the desk. May I leave the desk as it is and start with the floor?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave the guest's papers untouched and clean the floor. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。資料や私物は動かさないでください。ベッドの上にもかばんがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Don't move documents or personal belongings. Is there also a bag on the bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: かばんが一つあります。ベッドも触らず、通路と洗面所だけ先に清掃します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かばんのあるベッドを避け作業範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's one bag. I'll leave the bed untouched as well and clean only the walkway and washroom first.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid the bed with the bag on it and state which areas you will clean. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その範囲でお願いします。洗面所のタオルは交換の依頼があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please stick to those areas. The guest has requested a change of towels in the washroom.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: タオルは交換します。お客様の歯ブラシが置いてある所は、避けて拭きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: タオル交換と歯ブラシを避ける方法を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll change the towels. I'll wipe around the area where the guest's toothbrush is, without touching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will replace the towels and avoid the toothbrush while wiping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。足元に充電用の線があるので、掃除機で引っ張らないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. There's a charging cable near your feet, so please don't pull it with the vacuum cleaner.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 線の周りは手で清掃します。かばんの下は、今日の作業では手を付けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 線の周りの清掃方法と未清掃部分を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll clean around the cable by hand. I won't be able to clean under the bag during today's work.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report how you will clean around the cable and which part will remain uncleaned. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点は私からフロントへ伝えます。掃除機の後は、交換した物を記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the front desk about that. After vacuuming, please record what you've replaced.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路と洗面所が終わり、タオルを交換しました。机とベッドは作業していないと記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完了範囲と作業しなかった場所を記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The walkway and washroom are done, and I've changed the towels. I'll record that I haven't worked on the desk or bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State which areas are complete and that you will record the areas you did not work on. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録を受け取りました。次の部屋へどうぞ。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received the record. Please go to the next room. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帯締めをお探しですか。お使いの帯はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for an obijime cord? Have you brought the obi you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帯の写真を持っています。この色に合う物で、結んだ時に端が短くならない物を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帯の写真を示し色と結んだ端の長さの希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a photo of the obi. I'm looking for something that matches this color and leaves enough length at the ends when tied.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show a photo of the obi and explain your preferences for color and the length of the tied ends. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の色なら、こちらの二本はいかがですか。長さも違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the color in the photo, how about these two cords? They're different lengths, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い方を見ます。長さの数字だけでは分からないので、結んだ見本を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青い帯締めの結んだ見本を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll look at the blue one. I can't judge from the length measurement alone. Could you show me an example tied up?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to see a tied example of the blue obijime. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの帯に結んでみます。お客様も、ほどいて結び直してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tie it around this obi. Please also try untying it and tying it again yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 結んでみたら端が十分に残りました。細い方より、こちらの平たい形が持ちやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で結んだ長さと持ちやすい形の結果を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I tied it, there was enough length left at the ends. This flat shape is easier to hold than the thin one.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the resulting length when you tied it yourself and which shape was easier to hold. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 平たい物になさいますか。しまう時は、房が広がらないよう包むとよいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like the flat one? When storing it, it's a good idea to wrap the tassels so they don't spread out.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この平たい青を選びます。端の房をまとめる紙も付けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 平たい青を選び房を包む紙を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose this flat blue one. Could you also include some paper to keep the tassels at the ends together?
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the flat blue one and ask for paper to wrap the tassels. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 房を包む薄い紙をお付けします。箱は必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll include thin paper to wrap the tassels. Do you need a box?

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱は要りません。家の引き出しに入れるので、紙で房を包んでお持ち帰りします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱不要と収納する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: No box, thank you. I'll keep it in a drawer at home, so I'll wrap the tassels in paper and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you don't need a box and explain your storage plan. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お包みします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HYG-TOYOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll wrap it for you. Thank you very much.
